items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...that’s the one that Bernard is killing – ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Bernard Ighner.

ctx.x: It’s got the Body Heat, Soul Saga (Song of the Buffalo Soldier), Everything Must Change, Boogie Joe the Grinder, One Track Mind, Just a Man, Along Came Betty – that’s the one that Bernard is killing – and then, for me, If I Ever Lose this Heaven. Oh man.

Yeah, for Everything Must Change, right. But, If I Ever Lose this Heaven, oh man. Al Jarreau doing all his vocal percussion. This one for, again, my generation, was another one of those that just looms large in our formation. Then back to Esther Phillips, Performance, CTI, small – oh, it’s got strings. Richard Tee, Pepper Adams, yourself.
